headline: UK Consumer Price Inflation Rebounds to One-Year High of 3.6% in October
summary: UK annual consumer price inflation rose to 3.6% in October, up from previous months and reaching its highest level in a year. Surge in motor fuel costs driven by Middle East tension was the main driver.
why: Official inflation data directly guides Bank of England monetary policy and British sovereign gilt yields.

impacts.name: British Pound
impacts.why: Higher inflation reduces expectations for aggressive central bank interest rate cuts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Headline inflation accelerating past expectations alters interest rate expectations for the Bank of England.
